versions.changelog:
Initial release with comprehensive Douyin blue ocean product collection and analysis features.

- Supports keyword-based video/image search with sorting and multi-dimensional filtering.
- Provides real-time Douyin hot search/leaderboard data retrieval.
- Enables public Douyin creator works collection via profile link or sec_uid.
- Allows fetching and analysis of video/note comment sections with interactives.
- Designed for Douyin product research, competitor analysis, trend tracking, and influencer content mining.
